summary: Enhance your skills with our SQL for Business Intelligence Training Course. Learn to analyze data effectively and make informed business decisions.
lede: SQL for business intelligence helps BI and data analysts turn structured business data into dependable reporting datasets. For professionals working with data or reporting requirements, the course develops practical skills to translate business questions into queries, profile source data, and build reliable joins and dimensional models. Learners also practise defining and validating KPIs, checking aggregations, and preparing dashboard-ready outputs they can explain to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: SQL for Business Intelligence is designed for professionals who already work with structured data or reporting requirements and need stronger analytical SQL capability. It fits intermediate to advanced learners who can navigate spreadsheets or basic databases and want to produce more reliable warehouse queries, KPI datasets, and dashboard inputs.
modules: Business Intelligence Integration and Action Plan
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of accessing the assigned SQL practice environment and viewing supplied datasets. No production database access is required. The course uses controlled sample data, and exercises can be completed with a supported SQL client or browser-based SQL environment selected by the delivery team. Power BI or Tableau exposure is useful but not essential. Advanced topics such as dbt, Apache Airflow, and AI-assisted SQL remain at operational application or conceptual awareness level, while core SQL, data profiling, dimensional modeling, KPI construction, and query review receive hands-on practice.
